publication_mode: One public update commit over the previous public release; development history is retained separately.
included_development_changes: rtl/core/riscv_cpu_core.v: raise the misaligned control-transfer trap for a misaligned JAL/JALR directly after a not-taken branch
rtl/core/riscv_cpu_core.v: raise one trap, not two, when a misaligned control target is also an instruction access fault
rtl/core/riscv_cpu_core.v: pop the UART RX FIFO in the cycle of the MMIO read so back-to-back reads return consecutive bytes
rtl/core/riscv_cpu_core.v: mirror debug_status stores that complete through a D-cache victim-buffer hit
rtl/core/csr/csr_unit.v: make mip.MTIP and mip.MEIP read-only; they reflect the timer and external interrupt inputs
rtl/soc/mmio/mmio_read_mux.v: read write-only and unmapped MMIO registers as zero instead of the GPIO output value
tb/ and firmware/src/: four new regression programs and updated CSR and MMIO unit tests; each new test fails on the previous RTL
docs/: document read-only mip, zero readback, and per-class interrupt re-entry
release/current and release/implementation/basys3: regenerated verification and routed implementation evidence for the fixed RTL
publication_changes: README.md: state that the last board run predates the six RTL fixes and that the fixed RTL has no board run yet
docs/timing_baseline.md: describe the current routed critical path instead of an earlier build's path
SOURCE_IDENTITY.json: record the export origin and publication scope
evidence_policy: Recorded source_commit values are original development identities and are not rewritten to the public commit. They may not be reachable in public Git history. Package source manifests and artifact hashes identify the measured inputs and preserved outputs.
scope_note: The fixed RTL has fresh regression, formal, Sail comparison and routed implementation results. It has no bitstream or physical-board run; every recorded board result was measured on the earlier RTL.
